metadata.scenario: A new customer seeks a quotation for a full-day catering service for an upcoming event. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Frank Miller. I’m a regular patient, but I’m calling for a different reason today. Hi Frank! It's great to hear from you. What can I help you with? I’m planning a family event next month, and I wanted to get a quote for a full-day catering service. Oh, I see. Just to clarify, we specialize in home healthcare services. Are you looking for assistance with personal care during the event? No, no, I really meant catering. I thought perhaps you might offer that as well. I understand. Unfortunately, we don’t provide catering services. We focus on skilled and non-skilled healthcare services. Oh, I see. I was hoping you could help. Do you have any recommendations for catering services? I’m sorry I can't recommend specific caterers, but I suggest looking for local businesses with good reviews online. That's fair. While I have you, can I ask if there’s a chance to schedule my next appointment? Absolutely! When would you like your next diabetic management session and wound care visit? I’d like to stick with the same schedule as before, maybe next Tuesday around 10 AM? Let me check... Yes, we have an opening for you then. Perfect! Also, can you schedule transportation for me to my endocrinologist appointment next month? Of course! When is that appointment? It’s on the 15th at 3 PM. I’ll set that up for you. Would you like me to arrange for the same driver as last time? Yes, please! That’d be great. Okay, I’ll confirm the transportation for you. Thank you, Margaret! Really appreciate your help with everything. You’re welcome, Frank! I’ll take care of all the details and follow up with you. Sounds good! Looking forward to receiving the confirmation. Absolutely! You’ll hear from us shortly. Have a great day! You too! Bye! Bye!
